command: pre-registration of the compressed pose reader read

metrics.arm: phasebind2_rjpred@pca512_rj: exactly phasebind2_rjpred (own demo, rules v2, predicted carry, reader trained on 400 rendered scenes only) with the reader replaced by a ridge head on the 512 principal directions of the OTHER half of the tasks' rendered scenes (cross-fitted: a task's scenes never shape its basis; head stored fp16, 6.9 KB per task on average; the basis 16.8 MB fp16 stored once for all tasks); folded into W so the server is unchanged

hypotheses.RC1: PRIMARY: phasebind2_rjpred@pca512_rj non-inferior to phasebind2_rjpred at -0.05: one-sided 95% lower bound of the paired difference (two-level bootstrap, tasks then states) >= -0.05
hypotheses.descriptive: the same at -0.10; the exact sign test; per task; bytes per task (program + head) and the shared basis; the cumulative bytes over the 50 tasks against a rank-16 LoRA per task (18.7 MB)

metrics.offline: experiments/p6_compress.py (results/robot/p6_compress.json; practice first frames of states 20-29, 50 tasks): full reader median 0.152 cm at 443 KB per task; PCA-512 head 0.214 cm at 6.9 KB; PCA-256 0.242 cm at 3.5 KB; seeded random projection 512 0.244 cm at 6.9 KB (larger k in p6_compress_k1024_2048.json, descriptive)
metrics.plan: docs/PLAN_TRANSFER.md P6, storage: a task's bytes are dominated by its pose reader (443 KB of fp32 ridge weights over 16,384 ResNet-18 map features) once its phases take 2-3 KB; can each task keep only a small head over a SHARED code?
metrics.selection: by a rule on the offline errors only: the smallest per-task head whose median error is within 1.5 x the full reader's (<= 0.228 cm) -> pca512
metrics.tasks: the 50 stream-pool tasks (results/robot/p5_pool.json); init states 30-49, SERVE_SEED 0; 1,000 episodes paired with phasebind2_rjpred (m3_final, 874 of 1,000)
